# /hunt:tick

ARGUMENTS = what the user wrote with this request ([search id or title, optional]); empty if nothing. Skills named below are this plugin's skills (`hunt:<name>` in Codex), tools are the tools of its MCP servers (hunt, hunt-telegram, hunt-browser, hunt-bridge).

Use skill `hunt` and do one full run ("tick") for the active search (ARGUMENTS if given). Finish with a 5–10 line report in the user's language: what came in, what was sent, what needs their decision.
